title: AssetEditReady
description: An edit was applied and saved as a new asset. Both ids travel, because the point of the event is the pair: the original still stands and this one came from it. Keys are snake_case, not the camelCase the rest of leaf uses: this travels inside a Liquid envelope, whose own fields (event_id, occurred_at, event_type, owner_unit_ref) are snake_case and pinned byte-exact by signed golden vectors. The shape follows the wire.

original_asset_id.description: The asset that was edited, unchanged.

content_id.description: The new asset the edit became. Named contentId and not assetId so every result event points at its subject under one name.

session_id.description: The working session the edit was made in.

storage_key.description: Where the edited bytes sit in the store that holds them. Meaningful only to that store.
